data.title: Bitcoin’s Price Prediction: Will Global M2 Point to $300,000?
data.description: A chart circulating in crypto circles claims global money supply points to Bitcoin hitting $250,000 to $300,000, and prominent voices are taking it seriously. But the math behind it hides a flaw that lets anyone bend the prediction to fit whatever outcome they want.
